prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez, a 60-year-old lawyer from La Plata, Argentina. She was crowned **Miss Universe Buenos Aires** in 2024, becoming the oldest titleholder in that regional competition—though she later did not win the national Miss Argentina title.
